rationale: Revision 584a6b95 fixes the one defect I raised against c16f9859 (install now reuses a matching saved profile before any gh lookup, so offline direct repairs no longer fail), and its other changes—login-mismatch reported before id validation, a bounded retry on the mirror config lock for concurrent migrations, and --worktree-scoped author repair in clones that enable worktree config—are narrow, within approved paths, and keep the per-issue worktree attribution and provenance-based uninstall I verified earlier.
